hypothesis: MWCC GC/1.3 may assign the desired descending retail register sequence if the long-lived locals are declared in the same lexical order as retail r31 through r21. This differs from the earlier register-class-only and early-induction-lifetime experiments because it changes declaration order without moving any initialization or executable statement.
